_meta.purpose: The substitution TABLE only. The regex engine that applies it stays in Python (backend/tools/reasoning/_safe_wording.py) deliberately -- its value is being a deterministic pass over BOTH the LLM narrative path and the template-fallback path. A prompt-side rule can be ignored or drift; this cannot.
_meta.extraction_note: Generated from the Python literals by AST read. Pattern ORDER is significant and preserved: assurance_words run BEFORE phrase_substitutions, because some safe replacement text legitimately contains those words in a negated context (e.g. 'no opinion or certification is expressed') and running the strip pass second would mangle the filter's own output.
_meta.amend_policy: Patterns are case-insensitive regex, word-boundary anchored. Test any addition against the filter's own replacement strings before shipping -- a pattern that matches its own output loops the meaning.
